biotools.summary: clonevdjseq is a Nextflow workflow and Django-based software solution designed for sequencing, archiving, and analysis of VDJ sequences from clonal libraries, particularly hybridoma libraries. It offers a comprehensive and scalable solution for data management and analysis, with a focus on BCR and TCR sequence processing.
